notes: I found the mechanism: each character is shifted +1 in the alphabet (case preserved), then a 'Y' is inserted at index `floor(len/2)`. This explains all of E1, including why "a"→"Yb" (insert at 0) and "hello"→"ifYmmp" (insert at 2). I guessed wrap-around for z/Z and unchanged non-letters, marked as uncertain.
